premises.evidence_span: 93% of men still shop for clothes offline

premises.text: A marketplace connects men who hate shopping with style-savvy shoppers who find gear across the web and boutiques
premises.evidence_span: Branded is a marketplace that connects men who hate shopping with people that love to shop

premises.text: MAIL collects sizes, likes, and style so shoppers match on brand ID and improve recommendations from real-time feedback
premises.evidence_span: Mail collects a bunch of data about what Joe likes to wear and what he doesn't, his sizes and his style

premises.text: Try-on with best-in-class pickup returns solves fit without repackaging or post-office trips; keepers are charged plus shopper tip
premises.evidence_span: giving him the best return service in the industry. We call it return like a man

premises.text: Shopper supply can scale from underemployed stylish people across many backgrounds who want to earn by shopping for men

value.text: Average men get trusted personal shopping online with try-before-you-buy fit
value.evidence_span: connects men who hate shopping with people that love to shop. And we let you try stuff on before you buy it
